g.text: One query row through attention: the quantities in the single-pass recurrence
a_i V[i, :] = row vector (1, d), summed into o_i
running state for query row k, after key i
m_i scalar: max of x_1 .. x_i
d_i' scalar: sum of exp(x_j - m_i), j <= i
o_i' row (1, d): weighted sum of V rows so far
d_i' = d_(i-1)' exp(m_(i-1) - m_i) + exp(x_i - m_i)
Rows of O are independent, so a block of B_r query rows runs the same recurrence with
m and d' as vectors of length B_r and o' as a (B_r, d) block; the key axis is walked B_c at a time.
